name: Dune: Awakening
tagline: Sidecar for a self-hosted Dune: Awakening battlegroup, with an optional native plugin.
requirements: Self-hosted battlegroup with a Funcom self-hosting token
AVX2 CPU and ~16 GB RAM for one map server
Docker Compose or Node.js 22 with access to the battlegroup's Postgres and game RabbitMQ

assets.label: Sidecar
assets.hint: Required. Run it on the battlegroup's network; needs the two GM gates on every map server.

assets.label: Plugin (optional)
assets.requires: Self-hosted Dune: Awakening Linux map server
assets.hint: Optional. LD_PRELOAD on the map server process only; adds kill events and live positions.
